title: JD Vance says chat with engineer revealed America's real economic crisis

Economist Mark Zandi also warned about persistent inflation resulting from policy decisions.  These factors are reshaping the American economy and impacting citizens.  Both experts point to policy choices as the root of these economic concerns.

title: US man arrested for wiping phone during airport search; Android OS may trouble Europe travellers

GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused operating system, is central to the ongoing legal proceedings. Authorities in Europe also reportedly view GrapheneOS usage with suspicion. GrapheneOS developers state their software is legal and protects against unauthorized data extraction.

title: Burkina Faso channels $6B in gold into official trade in six months

The military-led government says its mining reforms aim to bring more artisanal gold into the formal economy, reduce smuggling, improve transparency and increase state revenue. It has also expanded mining oversight, formed new cooperatives and continued investments in electricity infrastructure.

title: Seawater ‘blood test’ may reveal coral reef damage before it shows
content: Researchers are using water chemistry and microbes to monitor coral reef health.  Ocean currents significantly influence these chemical and microbial patterns.  This approach mirrors human medicine's early disease detection methods.  It allows for detecting changes before visible stress appears on corals.  This interdisciplinary work aims to protect vital ocean ecosystems.

title: How Europe's heatwave is proving Americans right about air conditioning
content: Europeans are now buying air conditioning units in unprecedented numbers. This trend is driven by record heatwaves and rising health concerns across the continent. Manufacturers report significant sales growth for cooling solutions in several European countries. Previously, air conditioning was viewed as an unnecessary luxury by many Europeans. This cultural shift reflects a growing understanding of cooling as an essential need.

title: Missile shortage forces US Army to return to older PAC-2 Patriot interceptors
content: The US Army has ordered Patriot PAC-2 GEM-T missiles after a thirty-year hiatus.  This move addresses critical missile shortages driven by global conflicts and demand.  Ukraine and several allied nations are also procuring these effective ballistic missile interceptors.  Raytheon and Lockheed Martin are increasing production of various Patriot missile variants.  These efforts aim to stabilize munitions supply chains for ongoing operational needs.

title: History made! West Indies pacer achieves never-seen-before feat vs Pak
content: Justin Greaves made Test cricket history with five consecutive wicket-maidens. He achieved this remarkable feat against Pakistan during the opening Test match. Greaves finished with career-best figures of five wickets for just twenty-seven runs. This performance triggered a dramatic collapse in the Pakistan batting lineup. The West Indies all-rounder secured a significant first-innings lead for his team.

title: 'Issue far from settled': Govt rejects Meta's explanation on 'removal' of PM Modi's video

Meta's response was deemed unreasonable by officials after the post was briefly unavailable. The ministry summoned Meta's global head of public policy regarding the incident. title: Retired Delhi Police officers to hold dharna over attacks on cops during student protests

They will comply with all police directions and relevant laws.

title: Australia's housing downturn weighs on economy; higher rates and tax changes drag demand
content: Australia's once-booming housing market is seeing a rapid decline after a prolonged period of expansion. Increased interest rates and tax changes are driving property values down. The decrease in home sales is affecting consumer spending and construction efforts nationwide. Many families are delaying their purchases, expecting further price drops and coping with rising costs. This correction may be one of the most substantial downturns in Australia’s housing history.

title: France's greatest icon returns! Zinedine Zidane appointed head coach

Zidane expressed his excitement and called this the happiest day of his coaching career. He had waited five years for this opportunity, turning down other offers. Zidane's first match will be against Turkey in the UEFA Nations League.

title: Can using E20 petrol lead to insurance claim rejection? What govt said

Government sources have dismissed claims that using E20 fuel will invalidate vehicle insurance policies. Assertions about widespread engine damage or insect attraction from ethanol-blended petrol lack scientific basis. The Ethanol Blending Programme is scientifically validated and implemented with industry consultation.

title: India-US ramp up defence and civil nuclear cooperation; supply chains, AI in focus

This engagement strengthens critical supply chains and creates jobs in the United States. India has significantly expanded defense procurements from the US over two decades. title: The Harbhajan Singh hand behind Saransh Jain's India breakthrough

Four months later, the off-spinner will board a flight to Sri Lanka for the two-match Test series, starting on August 15 in Galle.

title: 'I would lose faith in the system if this resume didn't get hired': Ex-Google recruiter

With nearly two decades of recruitment experience at companies like Google, Uber and Walmart, Rao says recruiters increasingly value real-world achievements, internships, competitive programming, projects and problem-solving skills. His advice highlights how students can stand out by building, creating and demonstrating practical abilities beyond academic qualifications.

title: Infallible, impervious, precise: How IAF transformed its bombing capability

The Kargil conflict marked a genuine start with improvised targeting systems.  Balakot air strikes in 2019 used advanced munitions for deliberate precision.  Operation Sindoor in 2025 showcased a fully precision weapon campaign.
